verdict.rationale: No evidence pack mentions of a public API for NotebookLM/Gemini Notebook at all; all citations describe UI-only features (chat, audio/video overviews, mind maps, slide decks, sharing) with no mention of programmatic/API access replicating these. Since API access is a plausible axis for a SaaS product, absence of evidence yields 'none' rather than 'na'.
